verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              ततो रात्रौ व्यतीतायां प्रतिबुद्धोऽस्मि भारत। ततः सञ्चिन्त्य वै स्वप्नमवापं हर्षमुत्तमम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhishma said When they had passed away, I awoke. O Bharata; I was filled with great joy as I thought of the dream.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समभवद्युद्धं मम तस्य च भारत। तुमुलं सर्वभूतानां लोमहर्षणमद्भुतम् ॥२॥
verses.english: Then begin that mighty battle between him and me, O Bharata, which was wonderful and which made the hairs of all creatures stand on end.

verses.sanskrit: ततो बाणमयं वर्षं ववर्ष मयि भार्गवः। न्यवारयमहं तच्च शरजालेन भारत ॥३॥
verses.english: Then Bhargava rained on me a shower of arrows, which I baffled by a (like) shower of arrows, O Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: ततः परमसंक्रुद्धः पुनरेव महातपाः। ह्यस्तनेन च कोपेन शक्तिं वै प्राहिणोन्मयि  ॥४॥
verses.english: Thereupon he, of great asceticism, was greatly incensed and remembering what had happened the day before, he hurled, with anger, a dart at me,

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शां यमदण्डसमप्रभाम्। ज्वलन्तीमग्निवत्संख्ये लेलिहानां समन्ततः ॥५॥
verses.english: Which was as hard as Indra's thunderbolt, was equal in effulgence, to the mace of Yama, (god of death) blazing like a flaming fire and licking as it were with its tongue, all quarters of the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भरतशार्दूल धिष्ण्यमाकाशगं यथा। स मामभ्यवधीत्तूर्णं जत्रुदेशे कुरूद्वह ॥६॥
verses.english: Then, O best among Kurus, it struck me on my shoulder, even then, O perpetuator of Kuru's race, like a lightning ranging in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्त्रमस्रव‌द्घोरं गिरेर्गैरिकधातुवत्। रामेण सुमहबाहो क्षतस्य क्षतजेक्षण ॥७॥
verses.english: Thus wondered by Rama, O red-eyed one of mighty arms, blood flowed freely like streams of red earth from a mountain.
verses.bhavadeepa: धिष्ण्यं नक्षत्रम् । ‘धिष्ण्यं स्थानाग्निसद्मसु । शक्तावृक्षे च’ इति मेदिनी । जत्रुदेशे कण्ठकक्षयोरन्तराले ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहं जामदग्न्याय भृशं क्रोधसमन्वितः। चिक्षेप मृत्युसंकाशं बाणं सर्पविषोपमम् ॥८॥
verses.english: Greatly incensed , I darted, at the son of Jamadagni, a deadly shaft, comparable to the poison of a serpent only.

verses.sanskrit: स तेनाभिहतो वीरो ललाटे द्विजसत्तमः। अशोभत महाराज सशृंग इव पर्वतः ॥९॥
verses.english: That hero, the best of the twice-born, struck by it on the forehead, shone beautiful as a mountain with its peak.

verses.sanskrit: स संरब्धः समावृत्य शरं कालान्तकोपमम्। सन्दधे बलवत्कृष्य घोरं शत्रुनिबर्हणम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: Filled with great wrath he turned round, and drawing his bow with great strength aimed at me a terrible shaft, resembling death himself and capable of grinding all enemies.

verses.sanskrit: स वक्षसि पपातोग्रः शरो व्याल इव श्वसन्। महीं राजंस्ततश्चाहमगमं रुधिराविलः ॥११॥
verses.english: That fierce shaft struck me on the breast hissing (through the air) like a serpent, and I fell down to the earth, O king, covered with blood.

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य तु पुनः संज्ञां जामदग्न्याय धीमते। प्राहिण्वं विमलां शक्तिं ज्वलन्तमशनीमिव ॥१२॥
verses.english: Regaining my consciousness, I hurled at that intelligent son of Jamadagni a dart, bright and blazing as the lighting flesh.

verses.sanskrit: सा तस्य द्विजमुख्यस्य निपपात भुजान्तरे। विह्वलश्चाभवद्राजन् वेपथुश्चैनमाविशत् ॥१३॥
verses.english: That dart fell on the chest of that best of Brahmanas. And, O king, having fainted (from pain) he began to tremble all over.

verses.sanskrit: तत एनं परिष्वज्य सखा विप्रो महातपाः। अकृतव्रणः शुभैर्वाक्यैराश्वासयदनेकधा ॥१४॥
verses.english: Then his friend, that twice-born and great ascetic named Akritavrana, embraced him again and again and soothed him with words of auspicious import.

verses.sanskrit: समाश्वस्तस्ततो रामः क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः। प्रादुश्चक्रे तदा ब्राह्मं परमास्त्रं महाव्रतः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Thus comforted, Rama was filled with anger and vindictiveness, and that keeper of all observances brought forth a mighty weapon of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तत्प्रतिघातार्थं ब्राह्ममेवास्त्रमुत्तमम्। मया प्रयुक्तं जज्वाल युगान्तमिव दर्शयत् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Then, for the purpose of baffling also, I aimed the same excellent weapon of Brahma, which blazed forth, appearing like what happens at the end of the Yuga (at the final destruction).

verses.sanskrit: तयोर्ब्रह्मास्त्रयोरासीदन्तरा वै समागमः। असम्प्राप्यैव रामं च मां च भारतसत्तम ॥१७॥
verses.english: Then those two Brahmic weapons met each other in mid-air, without being able to reach either Rama or myself, 0 best of Bharata's race.

verses.sanskrit: ततो व्योम्नि प्रादुरभूत्तेज एव हि केवलम्। भूतानि चैव सर्वाणि जग्मुरार्तिं विशांपते ॥१८॥
verses.english: Thereupon, in mid-welkin, only a flame blazed forth, and 0 lord of earth, all creatures becomes greatly afflicted,

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयश्च सगन्धर्वा देवताश्चैव भारत। सन्तापं परमं जग्मुरस्रतेजोभिपीडिताः ॥१९॥
verses.english: The Rishis, and the gods together with the Gandharvas, 0 Bharata, became greatly afflicted, struck by the blazing effulgence.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चचाल पृथिवी सपर्वतवनद्रुमा। सन्तप्तानि च भूतानि विषादं जग्मुरुत्तमम् ॥२०॥
verses.english: Then the earth, with the mountains, forests and trees, began to tremble, and all creatures, becoming heated, became highly afflicted.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजज्वाल नभो राजन् धूमायन्ते दिशो दश। न स्थातुमन्तरिक्षे च शेकुराकाशगास्तदा ॥२१॥
verses.english: The firmament, О king, began to burn the ten points of the compass were filled with smoke. At that moment, those creatures that range the sky could not stay there.

verses.sanskrit: ततो हाहाकृते लोके सदेवासुरराक्षसे। इदमन्तरमित्येवं मोक्तुकामोऽस्मि भारत ॥२२॥
verses.english: While during this time all creatures, with the gods, the Asuras and Rakshasas began uttering exclamations of woe, O Bharata, “This is the time,” thought I and become desirous of shooting,

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्वापमस्त्रं त्वरितो वचनाद्ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। विचित्रं च तदस्रं मे मनसि प्रत्यभात्तदा ॥२३॥
verses.english: That weapon Prasvapa speedily, according to the words of command of the speakers of Brahma. And the Mantras also for using that weapon suddenly came to my mind.
